title: Turkish-Style Menemen with Savory Eggs
description: A gluten-free, savory twist on traditional Turkish menemen eggs, perfect for a quick breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Crack the savory eggs into a bowl and whisk them lightly.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomato and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the Turkish bread, sliced into small pieces, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Push the bread mixture to one side of the pan.
Pour the whisked eggs over the other side of the pan and cook until the eggs start to set.
Add the Turkish eggs, chopped into small pieces, and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt, black pepper, paprika, and red pepper flakes to taste.
Fold the bread mixture into the eggs and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
